newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields fall on Bulgaria floating interest T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bulgaria floating interest T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell on Bulgaria's Finance Ministry floating interest T-bills with maturities of six, nine and 12 months auctioned on Monday as a cut in the central bank main interest rate went into force, central bank figures showed.
Yields to maturity on the three issues were 28.59, 44.61 and 59.30 percent, down from 34.01, 53.58 and 70.77 percent at the respective auctions a week earlier.

The average accepted prices for the three issues auctioned on Monday were 97.73, 95.78 and 95.0 percent of par against 97.84, 95.5 and 95.0 percent of par for the three respective maturities auctioned on May 12. Interest on the issues is due at maturity. It is set equal to the central bank main interest rate for each of the issues and is adjusted every time the rate changes.
A cut in the central bank main interest rate to 4.29 percent monthly from previous 5.2 percent became effective today.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 9,693.9 million levs 1,300 million levs
Average price of bids 97.61 pct 95.78 pct
Bids approved 8,000 million levs 1,300 million levs
Average yield to maturity 28.59 pct 44.61 pct
